nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=70 beats='Last week of the harvest fair in Brackenford. Idris counts change at the honey stall of Aunt Sefa and two brass grain-marks ring differently on the counter, one bright, one dull.'>>

choices.label: Look closer at the two tokens

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=75 beats='Idris compares the two tokens: the heavy mark shows seven grains on the wheat sheaf, the light one only six, with a shiny rim. A wool-buyer waits for her change.'>>

choices.label: Show the tokens to Aunt Sefa
Mark the tokens and keep both
Ask the wool-buyer about her change

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=120 beats='Aunt Sefa squints at both tokens, says mind the stall not the metal, but lets Idris keep the odd light mark tucked in a wax wrap for later.'>>

choices.label: Let it go and mind the stall
Take the tokens to Petra after closing
Listen to the talk at the cider stand

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=120 beats='Idris scratches a tiny bee into each token to mark it, swaps them out of the till for coins of his own, and plans a fair test after closing.'>>

choices.label: Hear the gossip at the cider stand
Trade your own coins for every light mark
Show Petra the marked tokens at closing

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=120 beats='The wool-buyer says the eel stall gave her light change all week, and prices creep at some stalls: nine light marks for a honey pot that costs eight heavy ones.'>>

choices.label: Accuse the eel-seller right now
Find Petra and plan a proper test
Quietly ask other stallholders

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=130 beats='Idris drops the question, trades honestly through the last fair days, and rides home with Aunt Sefa; the odd token sits forgotten in a drawer until next season.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=130 beats='Idris quietly swaps his own heavy coins for every light mark that crosses the stall, protecting the customers one by one until his purse is empty; the fair ends with kind words from Aunt Sefa and the mystery unsolved.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=130 beats='With no proof Idris accuses Dorrin the eel-seller before a crowd; Dorrin empties his till to show fair change, Aunt Sefa apologizes for her nephew, and Idris is sent home early.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='Shift done, Idris hurries down Scale Lane with both tokens in the wax wrap, rehearsing what to tell Petra about grains and rims.'>>

choices.label: Hurry to the scale workshop

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='At the cider stand the talk confirms it: several rows now quote two prices, one for heavy marks and one for light, and nobody remembers deciding that.'>>

choices.label: Take the question to the beam balance

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='At closing Petra turns a light mark over twice and bets her best file that it is underweight; she says the beam balance in the workshop of her father will settle it.'>>

choices.label: Go weigh the tokens properly

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='Three stallholders admit quietly quoting two prices; each thought the Guild had approved it, and each is relieved somebody is finally asking questions.'>>

choices.label: Gather the tokens and find Petra

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=75 beats='Evening in the workshop of Master Halvard the scale-maker. Tokens gleam beside the beam balance while Petra sets out brass weights and Idris lines up the marked tokens.'>>

choices.label: Weigh a big sample on the balance
Study the stamps under the lens
Shadow Treasurer Varro tomorrow

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=120 beats='The fine balance shows every six-grain mark two grains short of the seven-grain minting; Petra logs forty tokens in a neat column, and every light one comes from this season.'>>

choices.label: Post the findings on the Guild notice board
Ask Master Quill to certify the weights
Take the numbers to the minthouse

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=120 beats='Under the bench lens the light stamp shows six grains and a blunt letter R in BRACKENFORD; the old stamp has seven grains and crisp letters. Two different dies made these tokens.'>>

choices.label: Show clerk Onnie the two stamps
Leave it with the minthouse ledger note
Set a granary watch for tonight

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=120 beats='They shadow Treasurer Varro: locked satchels at noon, the river door, and a glittering trail of brass filings dribbled along the path to the old granary by the ford.'>>

choices.label: Creep up to the counting house window
Follow the barrow to the granary
Send Petra inside with a mended scale

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=130 beats='Idris posts the weighing table on the Guild notice board; stallholders start checking their change, the Guild pays a small finder fee, and the fair feels a shade fairer.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=130 beats='Clerk Onnie checks the die ledger, finds no new die ordered since spring, and files a formal report; she lends Idris the old mint history, and Idris writes the tale of the seven-grain die for the school ledger.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=130 beats='A shutter swings, lamplight catches Idris at the counting house glass, and Varro sees exactly who is watching; by morning the room is scrubbed, every sack is gone, and the trail is cold.'>>

<<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='Master Quill the assayer weighs both mintings three times, signs a chit certifying two grains light, and warns that a chit proves shortness, not the hand behind it.'>>

choices.label: Carry the chit to the Harvest Court

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='Clerk Onnie unlocks the master die case: seven grains, crisp letters, honest wear. Whatever struck the light tokens was never kept in the minthouse, and she says so in writing.'>>

choices.label: Bring her letter to the Harvest Court

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='From the granary loft they watch Varro feed seven-grain marks to a hand press while Fenn the die-cutter stamps six-grain blanks; warden Brona and her lanterns ring the doors before dawn.'>>

choices.label: Go with the wardens to the court

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='Delivering the mended scale, Petra memorizes the open exchange ledger: reminting fees, week after week, in the same sloped hand that signs for Treasurer Varro.'>>

choices.label: Take the copied page to the court

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=75 beats='Morning, the Harvest Court on the green. Wardens have crated the granary press, two false dies, and the fee ledger; Varro pleads lawful reminting while Guildmother Ashe calls for evidence.'>>

choices.label: Lay out the chain of proof yourself
Let Fenn the die-cutter speak first
Call for the great market scale

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=120 beats='Idris asks to speak and lays the chain in order: the two-grain gap, the two stamps, the filings trail, the fee ledger, the granary night, each link handed to the next.'>>

choices.label: Hand the court the fee ledger last
Offer the council a quiet settlement
Let Varro answer each link in turn

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=120 beats='Ashe offers Fenn leniency to speak; the die-cutter turns the locked die box over in his hands, looking from Varro to the crowd and back again.'>>

choices.label: Back the story of Fenn with the ledger
Let Varro cross-question Fenn
Ask Fenn to open the die box himself

nodes.body: <<FILL role=decision words=120 beats='Idris asks for the great market scale: let a hundred of each minting be weighed before everyone, so the tokens themselves can testify.'>>

choices.label: Weigh the tokens and rule at once
Ask only for a recall of light marks
Let Varro run the weighing himself

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=140 beats='The chain holds; the court finds Varro took the missing grains, he repays the metal from his own strongbox, and the mint strikes a new seven-grain die with milled edges no shaving can hide.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=140 beats='The council settles quietly: metal returned, no trial, no names cried on the green; the market steadies season by season, and Idris pockets one light mark to remember what quiet costs.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=140 beats='Given the floor link by link, Varro talks each piece into fog, lawful fees here, routine reminting there; the court adjourns undecided, the treasurer resigns with honors, and Idris learns not to hand a clever man the order of battle.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=140 beats='Fenn tells how Varro brought him shaved brass and a drawing of a six-grain sheaf; the ledger backs every date, Varro forfeits goods and office, and Idris helps design the new stamp for the mint.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=140 beats='Varro lays every fault on Fenn and the court, weary, half believes him; the journeyman bears the sentence while the treasurer resigns with honors, and Idris learns proof must name the hand that profits.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=140 beats='Fenn opens the box: two dies, one honest, one six-grain, both cut to order under his hand; he names the day, the price, and the man who paid it, and the whole truth costs both men fairly and mends the market.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=140 beats='The great scale settles it before the whole fair, a hundred light marks two grains short on the beam for all to see; the court rules at once, and Idris and Petra are named junior weighers of Brackenford with brass badges.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=140 beats='The court orders every grain-mark recalled and reweighed at the minthouse window; the market is mended coin by coin, though the unnamed hand behind the light marks slips quietly out of Brackenford.'>>

<<FILL role=ending words=140 beats='Varro runs the weighing with gracious hands and a thumb nobody catches on the beam; the mintings balance, the crowd drifts off, and only Petra sees, too late, the smear of wax on the pan.'>>
